map.人员安全疏散时间估算（流量法）: Evacuation time estimate for personnel safety (flow method)
map.优先放大管径或缩短管路以降低管损，或提高水源静压（增设增压泵）。严禁以『凑数』方: Prefer enlarging the pipe diameter or shortening the pipe run to reduce pipe friction loss, or raise the static pressure of the water source (add a booster pump). It is strictly forbidden to lower the hydrant outlet demand just to make the numbers work, otherwise the jet cannot meet the firefighting requirement.
map.余量为负怎么办？: What if the margin is negative?
map.压力不足时需增压或减阻（放大管径、缩短管路），否则灭火射流不达标。: When pressure is insufficient you need to boost pressure or reduce resistance (enlarge the pipe, shorten the run), otherwise the firefighting jet falls short.
map.把静压、高程差、栓口所需压力和管道局部/沿程损失统一换算为 MPa，结果用于方案: Convert static pressure, elevation head, the required pressure at the hydrant outlet and local/line losses in the pipe into MPa in one go; the result is used to review the scheme.
map.水的重度约 9.8 kN/m³，10 m 水柱≈0.098 MPa，故 102: The unit weight of water is about 9.8 kN/m3, so a 10 m column is about 0.098 MPa and 102 m is about 1 MPa. This is the usual approximate conversion factor for elevation loss in hydrant pressure checks.

map.消火栓最不利点水压计算器。输入建筑高度、管道阻力等参数，计算最不利点消火栓所需水: Worst-case hydrant pressure calculator. Enter the building height, pipe resistance and other parameters to compute the required pressure and the effective water column at the worst-case hydrant, for fire water system design and acceptance checks.
map.消火栓系统设计中，需校核水源入口压力能否满足栓口压力、沿程与高程损失之和。: In a hydrant system design you must check whether the water supply inlet pressure can meet the sum of the outlet pressure, line losses and elevation losses.
map.消防验收与改造时，由静压、标高差、喷嘴需求与管损反推所需入口压力。: For fire commissioning and retrofitting, work back from the static pressure, elevation difference, nozzle demand and pipe losses to get the required inlet pressure.
map.算例：静压 0.8 MPa，标高 30m，栓口 0.25，管损 0.1: Example: static pressure 0.8 MPa, elevation 30 m, outlet 0.25, pipe loss 0.1
map.高程为什么按 102 折算成 MPa？: Why is the elevation converted at 102 into MPa?
map.：余量 = 静压 − (高程折算 + 栓口需求 + 管损)。余量 ≥ 0 判定『: : margin = static pressure - (elevation conversion + outlet demand + pipe loss). A margin >=0 is judged "satisfied"; <0 is judged "insufficient" and needs a pressure boost or reduced resistance. Elevation is converted at about 1 MPa per 102 m of water column.
map.：高程折算 = 30/102 = 0.294 MPa；所需入口压力 = 0.29: : elevation conversion = 30/102 = 0.294 MPa; required inlet pressure = 0.294 + 0.25 + 0.1 = 0.644 MPa; safety margin = 0.8 - 0.644 = +0.156 MPa >= 0 -> satisfied.
